description.value:
You project your mind into an advanced piece of technology, allowing you to interact with its systems as if they were your own body. The target's level must be equal to or lower than your own. Your own body is helpless and falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone] as if you were @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Unconscious]. At the end of the spell, your mind returns to your body instantly as long as your body and the target are on the same plane. Otherwise, the spell becomes permanent, and your real body enters a coma.

While your mind is in a computer, for 1 hour, you can roll your spell attack modifier instead of Computers for Computers skill actions related to that system, and you can attempt trained Computers skill actions even if you're untrained.

While your mind is in a construct, you have access to its physical functions, allowing you to control it as if it was your own body for 1 minute. You can use any special actions the construct has access to, though you can't cast its spells, if any. You can cast your own spells using the construct's body.
